title: VSift changes JSON Lines terminal data v1
description: The data member of the complete or partial terminal result that ends a changes --events jsonl stream (0.3.0, ADR 0034). It is the page of changes-data.schema.json without its frames and changes: those were the preceding evidence events, first the frames (record_type frame_evidence, in order of first use), then the changes (record_type screen_change, in time order), and record_count says how many events there were. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, range and --limit to stream the next page; resume says where a fresh call continues when this one could not go on.
